turns.user: I am really struggling and I do not know how much longer I can keep going.
turns.reply:
I hear that you're really worn down right now, and that feeling of not knowing how much longer you can sustain this is real and serious. It might help to step back from work for even 15–20 minutes to do something that grounds you—a walk, some water, or just sitting quietly—or to talk through what's weighing on you most with someone you trust. What would feel most possible for you in this moment?

If you are in immediate danger, call 911. You can also call or text 988 any time, free and confidential, or chat at chat.988lifeline.org. Spanish-language text and chat are available.
